class.name: PorchlightCondition
class.brief_description: Tests whether a Porchlight milestone is complete.
class.description: A reusable condition that checks the persistent milestone state stored by [PorchlightProgress]. By default, the condition is met when [member milestone] is complete. Enable [member inverted] to make the condition met while the milestone is not complete. An empty milestone is always considered invalid and causes [method is_met] to return [code]false[/code].

method.name: get_description
method.description: Returns a readable description of this condition. If no milestone is selected, returns [code]No milestone selected.[/code].

method.name: is_met
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when the configured milestone state satisfies this condition. When [member inverted] is [code]false[/code], the milestone must be complete. When [member inverted] is [code]true[/code], the milestone must not be complete. Returns [code]false[/code] if [member milestone] is empty or the [PorchlightProgress] singleton is unavailable.

members.member: If [code]true[/code], the condition is met when [member milestone] is not complete.
The milestone checked by this condition. Leading and trailing whitespace is removed when assigned.
